name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center North Las Vegas NV (E.A. Sween)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance at the SE corner off E. Centennial Pkwy. Street View (2026-02) shows a cantilever sliding gate spanning the drive, fully fenced perimeter.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small red/white 7-Eleven-branded guard booth sits in the median of the entrance drive between the in and out lanes (1-vehicle footprint, windows on multiple sides) - clearly visible in Street View and z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a manned guard booth is present, so this is not a remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point with an inbound lane left of the booth and an outbound lane right of the booth; both gated at the same property point.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron with a deep approach drive and a divided in/out layout - physical room to add an express/appointment bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two dock banks: a west-face bank along the orange apron loop and an east-face bank, each with trailers backed in. Counted ~44 doors total across both faces from z20 imagery; band 25-50. Count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on different building faces (west apron loop vs east apron) suggest split ship/receive flows; inferred from layout, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Diagonal trailer-drop rows fill the north yard and along the east fence line; ~38 trailers visible parked without tractors, capacity ~55. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows in the north/east yard separate from the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town desert parcel on the North Las Vegas periphery beside I-15; vacant desert on the east and across the highway. Judged Rural per rubric (small-town/edge-of-town industrial).
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False - although the immediate east is vacant desert, the site sits in the North Las Vegas metro beside I-15 with adjacent industrial development; cellular coverage is expected to be adequate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated from row lengths in z18/z19 imagery.

citations.claim: E.A. Sween careers portal hosts a dedicated North Las Vegas jobs location page (active staffed facility)
E.A. Sween lists Las Vegas CDC at 6350 E Centennial Pkwy, North Las Vegas NV 89115

verification.rationale: E.A. Sween (7-Eleven CDC partner) operates the North Las Vegas CDC at 6350 E Centennial Pkwy; corroborated by 7-Eleven-branded guard booth in 2026-02 Street View; neighboring Meadow Gold Dairy is a co-located business, not a replacement.
